D/ [---]IVS PF AVG ; R/ [FEL TEMP REPARATIO]

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constantius II (323-361), fallen horseman issue of 355-361, Reece period 18. Obverse description: Draped, diademed and cuirassed bust right. Obverse inscription: [---]IVS PF AVG. Reverse description: Soldier advancing left spearing fallen horseman; the horseman wears a striped or lamellar garment of two parts which meet at his waist, and possibly carries a round…
